Ivy (PM): Quick sync: Acme pilot wants model-level caching + HSM compatibility. We need to lock sequencing across runtime/infra/security to hit pilot by end of month. Who owns deploy order and minimal scope?

Samir (Eng): Runtime changes: KV eviction, variant routing to quantized variant, and a 10% canary path. Estimate 3w dev + 1w validation. Blockers: KMS decision and infra ops.

Jonah (Runtime): Recommend feature flag for routing and canary fallback to baseline model. Avoid prefetch/batching changes for pilot.

Priya (Infra): Hosted KMS is near-term option. Customer-managed HSM adds ~4w (procurement + onboarding). VPC peering for on-prem adds a few days. Need Acme confirmation.

Eli (Security): I'll run a threat model. If keys must stay on customer HSM, we need full dataflow and audit plan. If hosted KMS with customer CMK is acceptable, prepare design doc.

Ivy (PM): Proposed sequence: 1) runtime dev, 2) infra KMS decision, 3) security signoff, 4) SRE canary run. If HSM optional -> soft-launch ~5w; if required -> ~9w.

Samir (Eng): We can aim for 5w if scope limited to routing + eviction. I'll block two sprints. Need regression harness and smoke tests.

Jonah (Runtime): I'll PR canary routing by Friday. Canary flow: 10% traffic, auto-fallback on errors or latency regressions. Need SRE automation for weight shifts and KV warmup.

Nina (SRE): We can operate the canary. Draft runbook with alert thresholds: P95 latency >200ms or error rate >1% over 5m triggers rollback. We'll staff oncall first 24h. Need KV hit/eviction metrics.

Priya (Infra): Procurement contact Hans for HSM PO. Ivy, confirm whether Acme accepts hosted KMS for pilot.

Ivy (PM): Reached out; Acme "prefers" HSM but will consider hosted KMS for pilot. I'll confirm within 24h and escalate if needed.

Eli (Security): Starting checklist: design doc, anonymized sample dataset, key lifecycle, audit log path, header changes.

Samir (Eng): CI plan: `/deploy canary --percent 10 --model X` with smoke tests hitting both routes and asserting fallback. Needs infra flag.

Jonah (Runtime): Ticket ROUTE-642 created: "variant routing + canary support". Target PR Fri EOD.

Ivy (PM): Action recap: Ivy confirm HSM preference (24h), Samir/Jonah deliver dev plan & PR timeline, Priya confirm procurement lead times, Eli produce security checklist, Nina draft runbook & alerts. Sync Friday 10:00am. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Build queued for ROUTE-642. Status: queued."
